summary: Defined the adaptive planning, blocker-recovery, and dynamic-task generation contract for Sprint 5.

messages.content: Use durable state transitions and validated recovery-task creation only after the repeated-blocker threshold; reject unknown owners/dependencies, duplicate recovery work, and dependency cycles.
Render recovery links, paused/resumed task state, blockers, and persisted replanning events from the durable dashboard payload as plain text.

decisions: Keep initial planning finite and frozen; autonomous task generation is reserved for architect-valid recovery work.
Pause downstream dependencies when work is blocked, then resume only after recovery and dependency completion.
Persist all adaptive events atomically so reloads and dashboard replay have deterministic state.
The existing task graph is acyclic and sufficient; no database task or dependency change is required.
